session.zh: 周末收盘复盘 · 美国 / 香港最近完整交易日为 9 月 11 日
session.en: Weekend close review · latest completed US / Hong Kong session Sep 11

headline.zh: 美股周五反弹但周线仍收跌，香港科技周线回撤更深；先进 DRAM 制造路线出现长期、非财务性的新增观察。
headline.en: US equities rebounded Friday but still fell for the week, while Hong Kong technology retreated more deeply; advanced-DRAM manufacturing has a long-term, non-financial new watchpoint.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 13 日早晨，周末没有新的完整美港股票交易日。以 9 月 11 日收盘计算，标普 500 收于 7,656.98、当周下跌 0.8%，纳指收于 26,333.04、当周下跌 0.7%；恒指收于 24,805、当周下跌 3.3%，恒生科技指数当周下跌约 5.4%。AP 记录周五油价回落及美国 8 月 CPI 同比 3.4% 后的美股反弹；这并没有抹去周内的宏观波动。Samsung 与 ASML 9 月 8 日宣布深化 High NA EUV 合作，Samsung 计划于 2028 年将该技术导入未来 DRAM 高量产；这是长期制造路线的公司计划，而非近期供给、订单或盈利事实。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 13 in Shanghai, the weekend has brought no new completed US or Hong Kong equity session. At the September 11 close, the S&P 500 ended at 7,656.98, down 0.8% for the week, and the Nasdaq at 26,333.04, down 0.7%; the Hang Seng ended at 24,805, down 3.3% for the week, while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell about 5.4%. AP recorded Friday's US equity rebound after oil eased and August US CPI registered 3.4% year over year; that does not erase the week's macro volatility. Samsung and ASML announced expanded High NA EUV collaboration on September 8, with Samsung planning to introduce it into future DRAM high-volume manufacturing in 2028; this is a company plan for a long-term manufacturing roadmap, not a near-term supply, order or earnings fact.

label.zh: 周度风险重估，长期供给路线待验证
label.en: Weekly risk repricing, long-term supply roadmap to verify

title.zh: 周五修复与周线回撤并存，长期技术计划不能替代当期基本面证据。
title.en: Friday's recovery coexists with weekly losses, and long-term technology plans cannot replace current fundamental evidence.

detail.zh: 美国风险资产在周五反弹，但标普与纳指周线仍下跌；香港的周度跌幅更大。市场将继续受油价、通胀与利率预期影响。将 High NA EUV 视作未来 DRAM 效率的潜在选项是分析判断；其量产时间、良率、成本和客户需求仍须验证。
detail.en: US risk assets recovered on Friday, but the S&P 500 and Nasdaq still declined for the week, with larger weekly losses in Hong Kong. Oil, inflation and rate expectations remain relevant. Treating High NA EUV as a potential future DRAM-efficiency option is analysis; timing, yield, cost and customer demand still need verification.

label.zh: 恒生科技指数 · 周度

title.zh: 周五反弹未改变美股周线回撤
title.en: Friday rebound does not reverse the US weekly decline

detail.zh: AP 记录标普 500 于周五上涨 0.9% 至 7,656.98、纳指上涨 1.0% 至 26,333.04；但两者全周分别下跌 0.8% 和 0.7%。油价回落及 CPI 数据接近预期支持了单日修复，不构成对宏观风险消退的证明。
detail.en: AP recorded a 0.9% Friday gain for the S&P 500 to 7,656.98 and a 1.0% gain for the Nasdaq to 26,333.04; both still fell 0.8% and 0.7%, respectively, for the week. Oil's pullback and CPI data near expectations supported a one-day recovery, not proof that macro risk has faded.

title.zh: 香港科技周线承压更明显
title.en: Hong Kong technology faced greater weekly pressure

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指于周五收于 24,805、当周下跌 3.3%，恒生科技指数收于 4,320、当周下跌约 5.4%。低成交与美国进一步加息预期是报道中的情绪背景；这并非腾讯或泡泡玛特经营变化的直接证据。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng closed Friday at 24,805, down 3.3% for the week, while the Hang Seng Tech Index closed at 4,320, down about 5.4%. Low volumes and expectations of further US rate hikes were cited as sentiment context; this is not direct evidence of an operating change at Tencent or Pop Mart.

title.zh: High NA EUV 是远期 DRAM 制造验证点
title.en: High NA EUV is a long-dated DRAM manufacturing checkpoint

detail.zh: Samsung 与 ASML 表示将扩大在 High NA EUV 与先进制造方面的合作；Samsung 计划到 2028 年在未来 DRAM 高量产中首次采用该技术。该计划可能影响未来的制程简化和效率，但尚非已实现的产能、单位成本或行业供给变化。
detail.en: Samsung and ASML said they will expand collaboration on High NA EUV and advanced manufacturing; Samsung plans to introduce the technology into future DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028. The plan may matter for future process simplification and efficiency, but it is not yet realized capacity, unit cost or industry-supply change.

title.zh: 现货存储数据仍只提供局部信号
title.en: Spot-memory data remain a granular signal

detail.zh: TrendForce 最近可验证的 9 月 11 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 均价持平于 54.333 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.14% 至 45.214 美元。周末没有新的完整交易日更新；不能把该现货观察外推成合约价格、HBM 盈利或 DRAM 基金回报。
detail.en: TrendForce's latest verifiable September 11 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 unchanged at $54.333 and DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 down 0.14% to $45.214. There is no new completed-session update over the weekend; do not extrapolate this spot observation to contract pricing, HBM profitability or DRAM ETF returns.
